name: Check out nightly-builds
body:
After a few years of doing release builds not on GitHub, we have come full circle, but in a different way.
We now do "nightly" builds (they actually happen when our main branch changes) and post them in a separate [nightly build repo](https://github.com/subsurface/nightly-builds/releases)

name: Release build (v4.8.5)
body:
Travis CI build log: https://travis-ci.org/Subsurface-divelog/subsurface/builds/483779260/

Please note that these are the CI builds - the official builds are at http://subsurface-divelog.org/downloads/
E.g., the Android APK isn't signed, the app.zip (instead of a DMG) for Mac is missing a couple of libraries, the Windows installer doesn't support BT/BLE.
